## 2024-11-20 - [Accessibility] Properly associate labels and error messages for custom form components
**Learning:** When building reusable UI components (like `Input`, `Select`, `Textarea`), users often omit explicit `id` attributes. This breaks accessibility because the `<label>` cannot be implicitly linked (using `htmlFor`), and error messages remain disconnected from the input element. Screen readers will not announce the label or the validation error context when focusing the input.
**Action:** Use `React.useId()` inside form components to fallback to a deterministic, auto-generated unique identifier if `id` is not passed as a prop. Always connect `<label htmlFor={id}>` and ensure validation messages are read by using `aria-invalid={!!error}` and `<input aria-describedby={errorId} />` pointing to the error message element's ID.
